# behavior-transform Pull Request

## Change

Describe the IO wrapper, receipt, redaction, docs, or compatibility behavior changed.

## Evidence

List the exact tests, commands, receipts, or CI runs that prove the change.

## Boundary Check

- [ ] No credentials, private session material, raw exploit details, bypass payloads, auth headers, cookies, raw private corpora, or client data.
- [ ] Receipts preserve hashes/counts/redacted references rather than private payloads.
- [ ] Focused tests or gates cover the changed behavior.
